summary: Storybook 10 lands as an isolated workspace app (apps/storybook) with addon-a11y configured to FAIL rather than warn. It renders the same output a consumer gets: styles/tokens.generated.css is emitted from @bydiorama/tokens (toCss + toTailwindTheme), never hand-authored, so a token change moves every story. Stories live beside their components in registry/ and are kept out of consumers by check:manifest, which now rejects any attempt to list a story/test file as distributable. Button ships Matrix, States, WithIcons and the mandatory BrandThemed story (AGENTS.md step 4). Verified end to end: the built stylesheet contains .bg-accent{background-color:var(--ui-bg-accent)} — a live custom-property reference, not a baked hex — which is what lets a brand scope re-skin utilities with no rebuild.

migration.manual: None for consumers — Storybook is a devDependency of this repo and can never be installed by `shadcn add`, because distribution is driven by ui.manifest.json rather than by the folder tree.
